maria (People Ops): Quick check: Alex wants to move his approved PTO from Nov 13-17 to Nov 20-22 because of a family event. The original days overlap our mid-quarter customer freeze Nov 14-15 and a sprint demo on Nov 15. Managers can approve if coverage is OK.

jon (Eng Manager): Is Alex the demo lead on the 15th?

lee (Product): He's a co-presenter but not the primary. We need someone familiar with the feature to run the demo.

alex (backend): I can swap to Nov 20-22 and also do a short handoff doc plus join the Nov 15 dry-run 9-9:30am remotely.

jon (Eng Manager): That should work. Post a handoff doc in #eng, list backup presenter (maya) and rollback steps. Managers: reply `approved` here for audit.

sarah (HR): FYI: intra-year swaps don't count against carryover. Also note, if the swap causes <60% team coverage on any working day we're required to escalate to People Ops.

maria (People Ops): Policy note: approving managers must ensure a written coverage plan and remote availability for demo owners. I'll file an audit note when approved.

jon (Eng Manager): approved

alex (backend): Posted handoff + recording link in #eng and tagged @maya. I'll be remote for the dry-run. Thanks.

maria (People Ops): Filing swap record now. Closing when the #eng post confirms. If remote attendance fails, manager to escalate immediately.
